description: Remove a material from the price book. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Nothing is sent to any customer, and estimates or invoices already written keep the line they were written with. Housecall Pro answers this with an empty success, which looks the same whether or not the material was there, so confirm with hcp_search_pricebook if it matters.
name: hcp_delete_pricebook_material
